Very good in every way!
Dec 2025 • Couples
The quality of the food is outstanding. Every ingredient appears fresh and lovingly selected. The pasta was perfectly al dente, the sauces aromatic and well-balanced, and the pizza had that unmistakable crispy crust that you only find in really good Italian kitchens. I would particularly like to highlight the homemade specialities – you can really taste the genuine craftsmanship that goes into them.

The service was also a real highlight: attentive, friendly, and always with a smile. The staff's recommendations were spot on and rounded off the evening perfectly.

A restaurant that prioritizes quality and offers authentic Italian cuisine of the highest standard. Highly recommended—I'll definitely be back!

Our favourite Sapa restaurant
Mar 2025 • Couples
Over five nights in Sapa, this was our favourite restaurant. Nice to have a drink on the balcony with the mountain view and entertaining traffic jams. The first night we had the vegetable coconut curry with sautéed chayote in garlic. The second night, we had the sizzling tofu with seafood spring rolls. All the food was really tasty. The homemade chilli sauce on the table was great. Very well-priced. The beers were cold. Staff were very friendly and meals were served efficiently. Would love to return for many more meals. Highly recommend it.

Friendly and attentive service, great for an informal meal
Feb 2025 • Couples
My wife and I visited for an early evening meal. The restaurant is on a street near the bottom of a long hill, and some people might be put off by the prospect of the walk back up. I'd say: don't, it's well worth a visit. 

I was impressed with the service. The guy who runs it was constantly chivvying his waiters to ensure that the customers were happy with everything. He was really friendly and found time to have a chat with us. Also I liked the layout - two rows of tables with each table having two long seats opposite each other. 

It was great for an informal meal. They do a combination of Vietnamese food and other stuff like pasta, pizza, if you want a change. The food was fine, the Vietnamese food of course a bit better than the "Western" options.
